meta.name: linkedin-thread-monitor
meta.description: Track which of your LinkedIn comments earned author replies. Flags the 6-24h warm-reply window where thread momentum peaks, classifies threads as hot/warm/cool/dormant, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for follow-up drafts. Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "what threads need follow-up", "author replied", "monitor my comments". Not for analyzing likers on a post (use linkedin-engager-analytics).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪你的 LinkedIn 评论是否被作者回复,并在互动最佳时机提醒你跟进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常在 LinkedIn 评论并想及时跟进作者的回复。
copy.tagline_en: Track which comments got author replies and catch the best moment to follow up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you comment actively on LinkedIn and want to follow up when authors reply.

howto.what: 它会检查你近 72 小时发布的 LinkedIn 评论,看哪些收到了作者回复,把帖子分成 hot/warm/cool/dormant 四档,并为 warm 的帖子起草跟进回复。依赖 APIFY_TOKEN;没有就让你粘贴评论链接。
howto.when: 当你问“今天哪些帖子需要跟进”、“作者回复了”等,或发完一批评论后想隔几小时回看时触发。

say.text: 今天我有哪些 LinkedIn 评论需要跟进?
say.note: 输出带作者回复状态的评论表

say.text: 作者回复了我的评论,帮我起草回应
查一下我最近 72 小时的评论,窗口设成 24 小时
say.note: 按指定小时窗口检查回复情况

howto.what_en: Checks your LinkedIn comments from the last 72h, sees which got author replies, sorts threads into hot/warm/cool/dormant, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for follow-up drafts. Needs APIFY_TOKEN, else you paste comment URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "what threads need follow-up", "author replied", "monitor my comments", or after posting a batch of comments when you want to check back later.

say_en.text: Which of my LinkedIn comments need follow-up today?
say_en.note: Prints a table with author-reply status

say_en.text: The author replied to my comment - draft a response
Check my last 72h of comments with a 24-hour window
say_en.note: Scans comments in the window you set
